gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: persistent RS stocks that hold trend on low turnover and controlled range may reflect supply drying up before continuation; this expands the candidate pool through a free, production-visible OHLCV field rather than adding random tickers.

2_history_check.exp-20260608-012/013: Compression-to-expansion was accepted; this run is not an expansion threshold retune because signal-day volume must be below normal and the rule must beat the accepted comparator.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-016: Accumulation-base breakout was rejected because old_thin regressed and drawdown worsened; this run avoids elevated volume breakout chasing.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-017: Quiet tight-range accumulation with elevated volume failed. This run tests the opposite turnover state: supply dry-up rather than absorption volume.
2_history_check.exp-20260609-002: Gap-and-hold demand was rejected; this rule is not a gap or event-day demand continuation variant.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Accept only if aggregate EV/PnL improve, no EV/PnL regression window, target sample >=20 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration guard passes, and the accepted exp-20260608-013 compression comparator is beaten.

hypothesis: Liquid sector-known stocks with persistent SPY-relative strength that pause on unusually low turnover and controlled range may represent quiet institutional holding pressure, expanding the default-off candidate pool without adding noisy tickers.
interpretation: The low-turnover RS consolidation source did not clear Gate 4 or did not beat the accepted compression comparator. Do not promote or locally retune this OHLCV low-turnover consolidation family on the frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that low turnover during relative-strength pauses is stale momentum or passive liquidity absence, not hidden demand. Do not answer by sweeping range, volume, distance-to-high, ret5/ret20, hold-day, cooldown, or notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially new evidence such as forward replacement-value rows, same-day production-visible catalyst provenance, or a PIT flow/ownership field. Pure low-turnover RS-consolidation threshold retunes should stay frozen.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping signal range, range-to-median ratio, low-volume bounds, close-location, distance-to-high, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Next useful evidence is forward replacement-value rows, a shared default-off helper that reproduces this exact replay and daily snapshot semantics, or an orthogonal PIT catalyst/flow field. Live activation would need a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The fixed low-turnover RS consolidation source failed Gate 4 or did not beat the accepted compression comparator. The likely mechanism is stale momentum: low turnover can mean absence of demand rather than hidden accumulation after next-open execution and cooldown.
